meta.description: Visible 8-step policy workflow: intake and PHI screen, search both knowledge bases, evidence gate, base-model-drafted cited answer, confidence score (verifier model probability plus citation and number checks), confidence threshold (80% by default), human review of low-confidence answers only (Approve / Needs correction / Escalate buttons), review log. Type /log to see the log.
